fields.statement: At bed13ffa ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-picks|describe-golden)$' -count=1: ok. daemon-picks.txtar with RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=1 GiB runs daemon --once: no 'Started', no rex.log, daemon status --json shows reason disk-low with '1.0 GiB free, under the minimum of 10.0 GiB'; at 20 GiB the same fixture starts one run; at 1 GiB with --min-free 0 it starts one run; --min-free lots is a usage error. Regenerating describe-golden with -update left the tree clean (min_free and disk-low present). Read the diff: daemonPoll1 skips both Resumable and Pick when low, marks every candidate disk-low with the free space; default 10 GiB; FreeBytes via statfs Bavail*Bsize. make check exit 0.
